scores.visual_critic_note: Clean grid layout and deliberate Tol palette show design intent, but 5 of 9 panels render completely empty in the screenshot — a hard visual failure that makes half the gallery look broken regardless of whether it's a timing artifact.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Stacked bar encoding bug: segment heights use `h - y(d.val)` (individual value from baseline) instead of `y(d.cumY) - y(d.cumY + d.val)` (correct segment height), causing visual overlap and misrepresentation; all scale domains are hardcoded magic numbers rather than data-driven.
scores.stress_test_note: No user-driven event handlers (no brush, zoom, or drag) means update storms, stale closures, and mouse-touch fights are structurally impossible; the loopMorph callback chain is sequential and safe, with the only minor gap being the absence of .interrupt() guards should init ever be called twice.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 9-panel grid is a single conceptual unit (morph gallery), cells are well-sized and clearly labeled, but simultaneous independent animations in all 9 cells compete for attention — perceptual evaluation of animation quality is limited from a static screenshot.

proposer: Merged `.each()` + `.attr("d")` into single `.attr("d")` calls for all three arc-based demos (barPie, donut inner, donut outer), and fixed `arcTween` to avoid the redundant double `interp(t)` call. Net: -3 lines, same behavior.
